archival_memory.diabetes_management: I have been managing my Type 2 Diabetes for several years. I have been taking metformin 1000 mg twice daily, which helps keep my blood sugar in check. However, my A1C still hovers around 6.9%. To improve my glycemic control, my doctor recently suggested adding a GLP-1 receptor agonist, semaglutide(Ozempic), at a low dose. This medication has been helpful in controlling my appetite, which is a nice bonus. I also regularly check my fasting blood sugar at home, and it usually stays between 125-130 mg/dL.

Additionally, I take a daily magnesium supplement, which has been shown to have a beneficial effect on blood pressure regulation.

archival_memory.medication_interactions: I am cautious about potential medication interactions, especially since I take both losartan and meloxicam occasionally. Additionally, I make sure to take my thyroid medication separately from my calcium and iron supplements, as they can interfere with absorption. By being mindful of these interactions, I can ensure my medications work effectively and safely.
